visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women occupy the foreground of a bright airport terminal. The primary woman on the left wears a beige cap and black jacket, revealing silver braces while smiling broadly. The second woman holds a white sign that says "WELCOME!!! Andy Tsai" with blue hearts. (2) The scene cuts to a wide shot of an airport arrival hall with blue-tinted glass doors and signage. Travelers push silver luggage carts laden with dark suitcases. Lighting is flat and bright, reflecting off the polished grey tiled floors. (3) A man wearing a green utility jacket, a white collared shirt, and a black backpack walks through the gate. He holds a large black padded instrument case. He smiles and gestures "shh" with his finger over his lips while laughing. (4) The man walks quickly through the terminal corridor, laughing while looking at the camera. A woman’s hand appears in the bottom corner holding a transparent pink cake box. Yellow variety subtitles and emojis appear on screen as they walk past digital screens.
